defect: The box matched (title + category + sub).includes(q) — 75 chars of an average 3020-char lesson, 2.5% of what the lesson holds. A word in the body found nothing.
It matched the pointed text as stored. 50 of the 52 lessons carry nikud somewhere ('בְּרִיאַת הָעוֹלָם'); nobody types the points, so the word printed on the page was unsearchable.
title + category + sub were concatenated with no separator, so a term could match across the seam between two fields.

before.how: node, same content JSON, the exact former expression (title+category+sub).includes(q)

after.how: browser at http://localhost:3040/gannenet/library, typed into the box, counted rendered a.card

change.lib/content.ts: normalizeSearch() strips nikud (U+0591–U+05C7) and geresh/gershayim, collapses whitespace, lowercases. searchTextOf() walks every string a lesson holds (minus the id slug), normalizes each field on its own, joins on newline so a term must sit inside one field.
change.app/library/page.tsx: Row carries hay = searchTextOf(lesson); the filter is hay.includes(normalizeSearch(q)). Placeholder now says what it searches, and the box got an aria-label.
change.content files: untouched — the data stands, only the reading of it changed

checks.bundle: unchanged — the page already imported both content JSONs
